title: LLM model (the endpoint + model an inferring call addresses)
description: The model object inferring calls: which endpoint enactor and which model name. endpoint and model are external references (addresses/identifiers of an outside resource), not articulated meaning — so they are reference strings, the same way a URL or file path is. One half of inferring's domain (prompt × model). NOTE: this used to be inferring's flat codomain {inputUtterance, endpoint, model, completion, transactionTime}; inferring's codomain is now an utterance (token = call provenance, claim = reply text), and this schema is the model INPUT object.

endpoint.description: Identifier of the LLM endpoint enactor (e.g. endpoint:groq, endpoint:cerebras, endpoint:nvidia-nim). An external reference.

model.description: Specific model name at the endpoint (an external reference). If absent, inferring uses the endpoint's default model.
